shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'uikit|landing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies --json && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text ThemeProvider && sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"
/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text ThemeProvider && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,185p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Header.md && sed -n '1,175p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Banner.md && cat vite.config.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/{Header/Header,ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures,Banner/Banner}.js | head -220 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/{Header/Header,ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures,Banner/Banner}.css | head -190 && rg -n 'ButtonBlock|interface HeaderBlock|interface BaseBlock|indent|animated' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/{blocks,common}.d.ts | head -55"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/YFMWrapper/YFMWrapper.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.{js,css} | head -175 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorBlocks/ConstructorBlocks.js && rg -n -C 2 'interface Header|renderTitle|overtitle|className|indent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/blocks/{header,extended-features,banner}.d.ts && rg -n -- '--pc-|--g-color-base-background|--g-color-base-misc|--g-color-text-warning' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/{variables.scss,themes/*} | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models | head -30 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/components/ConstructorBlock/ConstructorBlock.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/HTML/HTML.js | head -85 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/variables.scss | head -80 && rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-misc|text-warning|base-generic-ultra|base-warning-light)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 85 'interface HeaderBlock|interface ExtendedFeatures|interface BannerBlock' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts && rg -n -A 22 'interface Animatable|interface Block|type Indent|interface Button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/{constructor-items/common,components,common}.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/BlockBase/BlockBase.css | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js | head -90 && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.css | head -15 && rg -n -- '--g-button-(background|text)-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -25 && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n -C 2 'type Theme|enum Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'spacing-9|spacing-10|spacing-7|border-radius-xl' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -40 && rg -n -C 3 'CSS variables|--g-button|--g-color-text-primary|--g-color-base-background|--g-text-display|Custom' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -100 && rg -n -C 3 'spacing|breakpoint|0.5' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -75 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'isBranded|animated|animation' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/AnimateBlock/AnimateBlock.js | head -70 && rg -n -C 2 'getLinkProps|href' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/RouterLink/RouterLink.js | head -50 && git diff --check && cat package.json"
